class.name: LuaVehicleTextureNode
class.brief_description: A Lua script drawing a texture for a vehicle.
class.description: A [LuaTextureNode] whose script gets, after the drawing, the vehicle it draws for - its destination sign, a screen of its cab: [code]local drawing, vehicle = ...[/code], [code]nil[/code] for none. The vehicle is handed to the script as it starts.

method.name: get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle the script is handed; an empty RID for none.

method.name: set_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle the script is handed as it starts - set before the node enters the tree.
